Quiet pipe consumers retain their original patterns and options. Remove duplicated setup without removing or weakening any assertion.

Related to #470; depends on #474/#491. The separate root-runner follow-up is #505. This PR targets the CI foundation so its review diff contains its own migration batch.

Proof: all original merge-check assertion counts are unchanged; Bash syntax, lint and git diff --check pass. Full current-head CI is green at `2d266be`, including [Rust tests and the complete shell suite](https://github.com/chriscoveries/wick/actions/runs/36986622761/job/110773534033). Runtime failures were kept visible while Firestar crossed the real disk floor; no health override was added.
